newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco announces bunker fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco announces bunker fuel prices.

text.p: Saudi Aramco said Wednesday the price of its A-888 bunker diesel lifted from the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Yanbu stood at $194 a tonne, effective April 10.
A-888 from the Gulf ports of Ras Tanura and Dammam amounted to $213 a tonne.

Aramco's bunker price telex said the the price of its A-960 bunker fuel oil from Ras Tanura and Dammam stood at $101 a tonne, while the price of its A-960 from the Red Sea also amounted to $101 a tonne.
